result.summary: This is a narrow residential street characterized by multi-unit brick housing and dense on-street parallel parking on both sides. The environment lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, and the existing sidewalks appear narrow and partially obstructed by vegetation or parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross and for drivers to see them.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs where cars are parked

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs despite the high-density residential land use.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway visible

hazards.name: Narrow/Obstructed Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is narrow and appears to have encroaching vegetation, which may force pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the brick buildings

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing locations for residents.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Maintenance
interventions.description: Widen the existing walkways to meet accessibility standards and clear any encroaching vegetation to ensure a continuous path.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a three-story brick apartment building and a continuous concrete sidewalk. While the walkway is clear, the lack of a buffer from parked vehicles and the degraded state of the roadway pavement reduce the overall quality of the pedestrian environment.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: The red SUV parked at the curb limits sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the street

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt shows significant cracking and wear, which can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the nearby intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or additional street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is an urban intersection with sidewalks but lacks marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and absence of traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure and risk at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which fails to alert drivers to pedestrian crossing points and does not provide a designated space for walkers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection area in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection geometry increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway area between the corners.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven roadway and sidewalk surfaces present potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible throughout the foreground roadway and the left-side sidewalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to the curb, lacking a buffer from traffic. While pedestrians are present, the environment lacks crossing infrastructure, street lighting, and traffic calming measures within the visible mid-block section.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the roadway where pedestrians are walking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers if they attempt to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Silver car parked along the curb in the foreground.

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface shows signs of wear and patching, which can create uneven surfaces for vehicles and potential debris.
hazards.location_in_image: Asphalt surface in the foreground and middle ground.

interventions.title: Install Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Adding curb extensions at nearby intersections would shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Add a Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Implementing a planting strip or furniture zone would provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Improve Street Lighting
interventions.description: Installing pedestrian-scale street lighting would improve safety and security for people walking during evening hours.
